Geometry-derived analysis shows Mo and V each adopt octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Sr centers are surrounded by 10 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Mo and V octahedra is observed, alongside edge-sharing between Mo and Sr polyhedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Sr polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 30 sites.
